dedup.note: Fresh pending_workers root and jobs tree were read at baseline. The GitHub connector truncates the large historical jobs-tree response and did not provide a practical complete body-by-body read of every historical pending blob in this run; therefore a full physical blob-by-blob scan is not claimed. To prevent false novelty, repo-wide exact-key search covering repository paths, including pending, was performed before deep-check and repeated immediately before staging for INN, OGRN, exact legal name with INN, and confirmed brand+domain.
